visual.interpretation: Retrieved sparse visual-map points and appearance-map point updates; positive retrieval is not an independently verified EKF acceptance flag. Native trajectory is saved after LIO update and before that frame VIO feedback.

events.note: Leave cathedral for cloister; broader uncertain interval

reset_assessment: No reset inference from position jumps. Initialization log entries are retained; this diagnostic does not establish relocalization.

protocol.alignment: Reuse each full-sequence global SE3 and association CSV; do not realign per window
protocol.overlap_policy: Report next/previous boundary overlap and truncation; do not count overlapped windows as independent samples
protocol.recovery: Exploratory fixed criterion: after center, APE above 0.5m triggers an excursion; first subsequent 5s with all matched APE<=0.5m and no matched-data gap>0.5s within 30s is return-below-threshold, otherwise right-censored. No excursion means not applicable, not zero recovery. Not proof of relocalization.
protocol.reset_detection: Only explicit reset/reinitialization evidence in log; position jumps alone do not establish reset
protocol.diagnostics: Image intensity/black/saturation statistics, visual retrieval/update counts, pose intervals; no claim of novel recovery/gating mechanism
protocol.semantic_scope: OVO uses reference poses; original 18 runs and independent metrics are retained, not an integrated FAST-LIVO2+OVO result
